priority_loading.description: Load important context at start/end of window to avoid 'lost in the middle' problem

compaction.description: Automatically summarize middle content when threshold exceeded

caching.description: Cache static content (guidelines, rules) to reduce duplication

findings: Effective capacity is 60-70% of advertised maximum
Performance drops 15-47% as context fills up
'Lost in the Middle' phenomenon: information at start/end retrieved better than middle
recommendations: Use only 70-80% of full context window to avoid accuracy drop
Place important information at beginning and end
